title: Perplexity May Launch IPO As Early As Q1 CY27: CEO Aravind Srinivas
summary: Perplexity plans to file for an initial public offering as early as Q1 2027
detailed: Perplexity may file for an IPO as early as Q1 CY27, with CEO Aravind Srinivas saying its ARR has crossed $1 Bn.

The accelerated IPO timeline has put Perplexity on course to potentially join OpenAI and Anthropic in the public markets.
Perplexity's growth has been supported by its India push, which became the startup’s biggest market following strategic partnership with enterprise players.
AI major Perplexity has preponed its proposed IPO timeline and could file its draft IPO papers for a listing in the US as early as Q1 2027.
Speaking with CNBC, founder and CEO Aravind Srinivas revealed that Perplexity has managed to grow faster than expected which pushed the decision to fast-track the listing.
“The rate at which our business is growing, I wouldn’t rule out filing something in the first quarter of 2027,” Srinivas said during the broadcast.
As per him, the company has already touched an ARR (annual recurring revenue) of $1 Bn, surpassing its $750 Mn ARR expectations ahead of the IPO.
This allows the company to move the IPO timeline from the erstwhile target of 2028.
Earlier in 2025, Srinivas had said that the company will not go public prior to 2028 regardless of how the IPOs of AI leaders OpenAI and Anthropic perform.
Both of the aforementioned AI giants are in the process of listing in the US.
In fact, Anthropic is set to list on the US Nasdaq Global Select Market on Thursday.
The $64 Bn IPO, which values the Claude parent at $1.4 Tn, valued each share at $70-78.
Meanwhile, OpenAI filed for an IPO confidentially back in June and is eyeing a public listing by next year.
Perplexity AI was founded in 2022 by Srinivas, Denis Yarats, Johnny Ho, and Andy Konwinski, about seven years after OpenAI.
The company offers an AI answer and research engine which has been downloaded over 80 Mn times.
Its largest market is India, as per the founder.
To achieve traction in India, the company partnered with Airtel last year.
The deal saw Airtel bundling a free one-year subscription of Perplexity Pro to its entire user base of 360 Mn.
This led to an immediate 625% month-on-month increase in downloads to 5.9 Mn in July 2025, which later peaked at 22 Mn in October 2025.
Notably, Perplexity’s app downloads in India declined to nearly 14 Mn by July 2026 after the promotional offer ended.
However, its estimated monthly revenue from India rose from $34,000 in January 2025 to $156,000 in July 2026, according to TechCrunch.
More recently in June this year, Perplexity partnered with Tech Mahindra.
The IT services major deploys Perplexity Enterprise Pro across its sales and customer-facing teams, including customer partners and senior sales leaders.
